services.description: The P365 is a shop favorite for EDC, though we knew we could make improvements. Aesthetically, it leaves something to be desired. Adding serrations upfront aids slide manipulation and gives it a more lowing look. On top of that, we added diamond checkering for a little extra bite when doing press checks….it also looks cool. We kept the sides less aggressive so you don’t scratch that $175 holster you just bought.

services.description: The Saber slide mill came about from wanting an affordable OEM mill that reduced weight on the slide for EDC while maintaining the reliability and cleanliness of an OEM gun. We know you are working and doing life with your firearm on your body and don’t always want that lint and sweat getting into massive holes milled into your slide, much less dirt and debris when you are shooting it.

services.description: We designed the Genesis slide with the modern shooter in mind. We wanted milling that provided aggressive texturing up front to help with manipulating the slide but not something that would tear up your holster or hands. We also added the matching texture to the rear of the slide in case you aren’t running an optic and prefer to manipulate the slide from the rear. With windows on all three sides of the slide, we have reduced weight to help with felt recoil and allow the option for barrel ports. We also think it looks cool, but we might be slightly biased.
